title: Automaton Solo #018 (에메랄드 · 아이보리 관절 · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Middle Eastern · 메이크업 립온리 블랙 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 열대 정글 보드워크(비 갠 뒤) · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, blunt bob lavender hair — full body emerald-green enamel automaton with gold gears fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid emerald enamel automaton body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into fitted enamel plates, with one huge round cut-out window across her chest and belly as wide as her whole torso, showing a dense tangle of meshing gears of many sizes packed edge to edge inside a deep hollow cavity lit from within by a soft warm glow, stacked in layers at different depths with light pale-gold gaps between the layers so every gear on every layer is clearly visible, one giant gear as wide as her ribcage surrounded by medium and small gears, coiled springs and steel shafts, all turning together, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every plate ends in a round exposed hinge joint with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted plates — BLAZING glossy emerald-green enamel plates inlaid with gold filigree across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID gold gears with large white pearl bearings at their centres turning inside the cut-out window, pale ivory-white joints standing out sharply against the enamel, a large gold wind-up key as long as her forearm turning slowly at her side, mirror-gloss enamelled, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: hands clasped behind her head, elbows wide, hips thrust to one side — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same emerald enamel, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same emerald enamel with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the automaton body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: a clean bare face with natural eyes, thick opaque lacquer-glossy jet-black lips overlined fuller than natural, dominating the whole face.

Background: a bright tropical jungle boardwalk of wooden planks with a waist-high rope rail, large green leaves and standard-height steps, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
